_comment: National press pool for postgame press conference casting (docs/in_progress/PRESS_CONFERENCE_PLAN.md §2.4). Tiers are approved (D6). The notes field gives a one-line reason for every archetype's placement, read from newsroom/config/agent_personas.json. relationship_bonus stays 0 until PERSONALITY_RELATIONSHIPS_PLAN's relationship_context exists for this consumer.

notes.SCHEFTER: Top national insider: news-first, always in the room at a big game.
notes.RAPOPORT: National insider with deal background, the second insider voice.
notes.ROSENTHAL: Breezy film-watching national reporter who travels to the week's best game.
notes.SANDO: Researched front-office reporter, a national game-day presence.
notes.CHADIHA: Veteran national feature writer on the human side of the game.
notes.THE_ATHLETIC: Subscription deep-dive outlet, a national reporter at marquee games.
notes.ESPN: Big-network studio reporter tuned to the national conversation.
notes.YATES: Crisp, factual national reporter with the numbers.
notes.BARNWELL: Methodical quantitative national columnist for the biggest games.
notes.SIMMONS: Conversational national columnist with the eye test and history.
notes.JOYNER: Evidence-based charting columnist, a national analytical voice.
notes.BERRY: Well-known national columnist with a fantasy bent; still a press-corps name.
notes.STEPHEN_A: Loud studio personality and TV presence at the week's headline game.
notes.SKIP_BAYLESS: Contrarian TV debater, a national broadcast voice.
notes.MCAFEE: High-energy TV personality and former player.
notes.ORLOVSKY: TV film-room analyst and former quarterback.
notes.SHANNON: Folksy TV analyst and former player.
notes.CLARK: Passionate TV analyst and former player.
notes.JJ_WATT: TV analyst and former defensive star.
notes.OCHOCINCO: Playful TV personality and former receiver.
notes.HERBSTREIT: Earnest national broadcaster with a college and pro eye.
notes.ACHO: Direct TV analyst with structured, confident takes.
notes.AGGREGATOR: A label-first national aggregator account, not a person who attends pressers.
notes.STATS_DESK: A stats account, not a reporter who asks questions.
notes.ROUNDTABLE_PANEL: A panel moderator voicing several people, not a single attendee.
notes.FANTASY_GURU: A fantasy analyst whose beat is usage and volume, not postgame pressers.
notes.DRAFT_SICKO: A draft-obsessed fan, not a national reporter.
notes.MEL_KIPER: A draft analyst; he covers prospects, not the week's game pressers.
notes.DIE_HARD_FAN: A team fan account, not press-corps.
notes.BANDWAGON_FAN: A front-runner fan account, not press-corps.
notes.FORMER_PLAYER: A generic retired-player account with no fixed identity for the room.
notes.SCHEFTER_TWEET: The tweet-only account of SCHEFTER; one person gets one seat.
notes.SKIP_TWEET: The tweet-only account of SKIP_BAYLESS; one person gets one seat.
notes.LOCAL_BEAT_REPORTER: The beat role: seeded per team from agent_memories.assigned_team_id, never drawn from the national pool.
